空きびん(飲食料・医薬品用): Empty glass bottle (for food, drinks, oral medicine; excluding pesticide and poisonous chemical bottles)
医薬品の空きびん: Empty medicine bottle (glass; oral medicine only; excluding poisonous or potent drugs)
カセット式ガスボンベのキャップ: Butane gas canister cap (for portable gas stove; plastic)
缶詰めの空き缶: Empty can (canned food; excluding rusted cans)
バッテリー(電子機器用): Battery (for electronic devices; excluding cell phone batteries, e-bike batteries, car/motorcycle batteries and large lead batteries such as UPS)
